content:
“Is tonight's dinner Rotting Roadkill Goulash Surprise? No problem!”

**Iron Stomach** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Provides Damage Resistance and Energy Resistance based on current Endurance while not diseased.

| ![FO76 iron stomach perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/e/ec/FO76_iron_stomach_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Resistances bonus | 
| | 1 | +18 | 
| | 15 | +61 | 
| | 30 | +96 | 
| | 60 | +131 | 
| | 100 | +175 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Increased Damage and Energy Resistance based on END while not diseased. | 00185A2D | 

Before update 56, Iron Stomach had 3 ranks and reduced chance to catch a disease from food by 30%/60%/90%.

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Adamantium Skeleton - Less limb damage
- Lead Belly - Less radiation from eating and drinking
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Natural Resistance - Bonus elemental resistance
- Rad Resistant - Bonus radiation resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
- Vaccinated - Higher disease resistance
